items.title: Enterprise to startup, a security career field report
items.summary: So you've joined a startup that's smaller than the security team at the enterprise you spent years building your security knowledge and career? You're discovering that much of what made you effective was the entire organization around you.This session is a field report on making that move: from an 85,000-person enterprise (and shrinking) to a 150-person growth-stage startup.Low-friction ways to improve security posture right away, methods for identifying gaps in need of immediate attention vs. those that can wait, and how to start building durable security hygiene at a critical point in your new company's history.
